scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-coefficient theorem; exact Weyl-integration checker independently validates Gram coefficients; finite checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for the three fundamental central trace characters of SU(4); no all-rank, stability-under-noise, or general matrix-coefficient assertion. Priority can remain uncertain for unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Sharp fourth moments and phase rigidity for the three fundamental characters of SU(4)
